objective: Define one canonical cohort-selection policy for created-at insurance reports so an omitted limit means the complete requested date range and an explicit limit remains an intentional bounded newest-N cohort.

semantics.omittedLimit: resolve the complete created-at range through bounded keyset pages
semantics.explicitLimit: resolve at most the requested newest-N relationships from one bounded keyset page
semantics.limitedCompleteness: hasMore false means the requested range happened to fit inside the explicit limit; hasMore true means the report cohort is intentionally truncated

rules: Omitting limit must never silently inherit the old CRM default of 50.
Explicit limit remains an intentional report cohort cap and is not reinterpreted as an internal pagination size.
Limited resolution performs exactly one bounded page read using pageSize equal to the explicit limit.
Limited resolution exposes whether additional relationships existed through isComplete and isTruncated.
All returned relationships are validated for canonical relationship identity, canonical UTC createdAt, and requested range membership.
Duplicate relationship identities are removed while preserving first occurrence.
Malformed page continuation metadata is rejected.
The resolver performs no economics, premium, commission, renewal, outcome, presentation, or evidence reads.
No reporting consumer is migrated in this slice.
No SQL, schema, migration, dashboard, deployment, or telephony behavior is introduced.
explicitlyDeferred: propagation of cohort completeness metadata onto each report output
created_at plus relationship_id compound database index
